passages.note: Senate floor vote page: McGuire is in the Aye list on 3rd reading of SB 880, and the 24-14 tally is far from near-unanimous.

passages.provision_quote: (a) Notwithstanding Section 30510, “assault weapon” also means any of the following: (1) A semiautomatic, centerfire rifle that does not have a fixed magazine but has any one of the following: (A) A pistol grip that protrudes conspicuously beneath the action of the weapon.
passages.note: Chaptered text of the same single-subject bill; the operative section prints the provision the vote page does not.

rows.reasoning: McGuire voted Aye on SB 880 (2015-2016), a single-subject bill ("Firearms: assault weapons.") whose operative section amends Penal Code 30515 so that "assault weapon" also means "A semiautomatic, centerfire rifle that does not have a fixed magazine but has any one of the following" listed features, extending the existing prohibition to that class of semi-automatic rifles and pistols and leaving other firearms in place. That is the rung "Ban semi-automatic assault-style weapons, while allowing other firearms"; the bill's own text excludes the rung that would "Allow all types of firearms" and reaches no further than assault-style weapons. The 24-14 tally is not near-unanimous, so the vote ladder lets this single-subject final-passage vote carry the chair.
